findings.entity: Left wall and booth area of the diner
findings.description: In the interior shot at 00:10 (and repeated at 00:51 and 01:35), the wall immediately to the left of the kitchen pass-through terminates after a short panel into a glass door/window wall right next to the counter aisle. When the camera cuts to a wider shot along the same axis at 00:19, that wall is gone and replaced by a wide dining area containing a row of booths and a window with a neon OPEN sign.

At 00:25, the man sits on a stool midway down the straight section of the counter facing right. After close-ups of the coffee and plate, the wide shot at 00:36 shows him seated at the far foreground curved end of the counter facing the camera, before he is seen back midway down the straight counter in the reverse angle at 00:45 and wide shot at 01:00.

In the wide shot at 01:22-01:26 (looking toward the back kitchen pass-through), the waitress sits down on a stool to the man's left, placing her closer to the back kitchen and the man closer to the front of the diner. When the camera cuts at 01:27 to the reverse angle looking toward the front of the diner (with the front beverage cooler in the background), their relative positions along the counter are inverted: the man is in the foreground (kitchen side) and the waitress is in the background to his right (front entrance side).

After standing up from the stool on the customer (left) side of the unbroken counter at 01:51, the waitress walks rightward directly through the solid counter structure at 01:52 to emerge in the service area behind the counter at 01:53.
